spanish: Y ahora, anda, guía al pueblo a lo que hablé a ti; he aquí mi ángel andará delante de ti, y en día de mi visitar, visitaré sobre ellos su pecado.

findings.issue: ángel narrows the common noun to a celestial being; the lemma and morphology leave the kind of messenger open
the conjunction on the sequential perfect is not expressed before the verb

notes: Person, number, the הלך and פקד repetitions, and the construct day are preserved.
